name: sgnl-focus
description: Run the SGNL method in a conversation: confirm 1 to 3 objectives inferred from what your assistant already knows, open an 18-hour cycle from a plate it reads itself (read-only, from what your app already lets it access), get 3 to 5 sgnls with evidence and the first bit already drafted, report done or blocked, and close with a recap and ratio. Drafts only: it never sends or changes anything in another system. Skills only.
